method: Each page rendered with Poppler pdftoppm at 100 dpi in 8-bit grey; the body pixels, excluding a 60 pt band at the top and at the bottom of each page (running header and page number), compared by SHA-256. A page counts as unchanged only if its body pixels are identical at that resolution.
relocated_pages_note: New page number to baseline page number. No page moved.
edited_pages_note: Pages whose text was edited. The other changed pages, 59-62, only reflow after the longer paragraph on the upper constant 12 in Section 18.
visual_check: All 21 changed pages rendered at 100 dpi and inspected in contact sheets of four pages; no clipping, overlap, missing text or displaced header or footer was found
tool: pixcmp.py, a Poppler pdftoppm comparison script; its method is stated above.
